POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, MAY 12, 2025

Sarah Bedy, Member  Doug Killion, Member
Pam Chotiswatdi, Member  Julie Lie, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Sara Bedy called the meeting to order at 2:06 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie

Also present: Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55248  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee Meeting of
  Monday April 14, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

2.  25-55249  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the draft 2025 Homeless
  Services Advisory Committee (HSAC) Policy recommendations to the Mayor and
  City Council.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

  • Chair Sarah Bedy reviewed the policy recommendation updates she made
  based on feedback from the previous subcommittee meeting and requested
  additional input on any further changes the subcommittee would like to
  propose.
  • Chair Sarah requested additional information on the City's approach to
  increasing shelter rates. City Staff will work on having this information
  available prior to the next meeting.
  • Subcommittee members provided feedback on additional changes that could
  be incorporated into the policy recommendations.
  • Member Julie Lie shared a high school student’s senior project, which
  involved distributing blessing bags and writing a letter to the Mayor urging
  the City to prioritize housing for individuals experiencing homelessness.
  • Additionally, subcommittee members had questions about how the
  recommendations are presented to City Council. They expressed interest in
  having their recommendations agendized, allowing the committee the
  opportunity to participate during public comment.
  •

3.  25-55250  Recommendation to receive and file future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

  • The subcommittee members would like to place on the agenda a discussion
  regarding the HSAC committee’s input on items that should be
  recommended to the policy subcommittee.
  • Another item recommended for the next policy meeting is the discussion of
  state legistlation and related policy apporaches.
